definitions.explanation: The process of creating artistic or creative works, such as films, TV programs, artwork, or music.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制作|せいさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took three years to produce this film.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧{制作|せいさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{携|たずさ}わる→携わる：09333_tazusawaru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.notes: 番組制作 = TV program production

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制作|せいさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{過程|かてい}→過程：02621_katei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I observed the process of creating an artwork.

notes:
{制作|せいさく} is used for creative or artistic production—films, TV shows, artworks, music, etc. It emphasizes the creative process.

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{製作|せいさく}→製作：04322_seisaku⟧: manufacture, production of physical goods (e.g., cars, furniture)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {制作|せいさく}: creative works (films, art, programs)
- ⟦{製作|せいさく}→製作：04322_seisaku⟧: manufactured products (machines, goods)
